pack.title: Asking for help
pack.description: Ask for specific help without pretending everything is fine.

scenarios.setting: You are overloaded and need a colleague's help with a deadline.
scenarios.jab: I thought you had this handled.
scenarios.goal: Ask for specific help without pretending everything is fine.

replies.line: I need help checking the figures before three. Can you take that part?
replies.why: It identifies a bounded task and deadline rather than making a vague appeal.
replies.delivery: Name the exact task and deadline; wait for agreement before treating the work as assigned.

replies.line: Can you check the figures before three?
replies.why: It makes the request easy to understand and answer.
replies.delivery: Name the exact task and deadline; wait for agreement before treating the work as assigned.

replies.line: I've reached capacity; could you check the figures before three so I can finish the draft?
replies.why: It explains how a specific contribution would help the shared task.
replies.delivery: Name the exact task and deadline; wait for agreement before treating the work as assigned.

replies.line: My spreadsheet needs a second pair of eyes; yours available before three?
replies.why: A light phrase keeps the help request concrete without diminishing the work.
replies.delivery: Name the exact task and deadline; wait for agreement before treating the work as assigned.

followUp.jab: I don't have time for the whole thing.
followUp.line: I'm asking for the figures only; if you can't, I'll find another way.
followUp.why: It narrows the request and allows an honest refusal without guilt.
followUp.delivery: Name the exact task and deadline; wait for agreement before treating the work as assigned.
